algebra.title: Algebra
algebra.content:
Algebra

#import "@preview/fletcher:0.5.8" as fletcher: diagram, node, edge;
 
#let w = 7.2em;
#let h = 2.7em;
 
#diagram(
	spacing: (3.8em, 2.5em),
	node-stroke: luma(80%),
	label-size: 0.9em,
	
	node((0,0), [*Measure space*], name: <ms>, width:w, height:h),
	node((1,0), [*Set*], name: <s>, width:w, height:h),
	node((0,1), [*Probability space*], name: <ps>, width:w, height:h),
	node((1,1), [*Topological space*], name: <ts>, width:w, height:h),
	node((0,2), [*Riemannian manifold*], name: <rm>, width:w, height:h),
	node((1,2), [*Metric space*], name: <met>, width:w, height:h),
	node((2,2), [*Hausdorff space*], name: <has>, width:w, height:h),
	node((0,3), [*Banach space*], name: <bs>, width:w, height:h),
	node((1,3), [*Normed vector space*], name: <nvs>, width:w, height:h),
	node((2,3), [*Vector space*], name: <vs>, width:w, height:h),
	node((0,4), [*Hilbert space*], name: <hs>, width:w, height:h),
	node((1,4), [*Inner product space*], name: <ips>, width:w, height:h),
	edge(<s>, "-->", <ms>, left, $Σ, μ$),
	edge(<s>, "-->", <ts>, $cal(T)$),
	edge(<ms>, "..>", <ps>, left, $μ(X) = 1$),
	edge(<met>, "->",  <ts>, $cal(T) = {⋃B(x, r)}$),
	edge(<s>, "-->", <met>, $d$, bend:-60deg),
	edge(<ts>, "..>", <has>, $T_2$, bend: 35deg),
	edge(<rm>, "->", <met>, right, $d(x, y) = inf{L(γ)}$, label-sep:1.5em),
	edge(<met>, "->", <has>),
	edge(<nvs>, "..>", <bs>, left, [complete]),
	edge(<nvs>, "-->", <met>, $d(x, y) = ||x - y||$),
	edge(<vs>, "-->", <nvs>, left, $|| ||$),
	edge(<hs>, "->", <bs>),
	edge(<ips>, "..>", <hs>, left, [complete]),
	edge(<ips>, "->", <nvs>, left, $||x||=sqrt(⟨x, x⟩)$),
	edge(<vs>, "->", <ips>, left, $⟨,⟩$),
	edge(<s>, "-->", <r>, right, label-pos:0.8, label-size:0.8em, [$(R, +)$ abelian group\ $(R, times)$ monoid\ distributive laws]),
	edge((rel: (15pt, -10pt), to: <s>), "-->", <ma>, right, bend:20deg, [binary\ operation]),
	edge((rel: (35pt, -20pt), to: <s>), "-->", <vs>, bend:75deg),
	
	node((3,1.2), [*Magma*\ #text(blue, $(ℤ, -)$)], name: <ma>, width:w, height:h),
	node((3,2),   [*Semigroup*\ #text(blue, $(ℕ, +)$)], name: <sg>, width:w, height:h),
	node((3,2.8), [*Monoid*\ #text(blue, $(ℤ, ×)$)], name: <mo>, width:w, height:h),
	node((3,3.6), [*Group*\ #text(blue, $"GL"_n (ℝ)$)], name: <gr>, width:w, height:h),
	node((3,4.5), [*Abelian group*\ #text(blue, $(ℤ, +)$)], name: <agr>, width:w, height:4em),
	edge(<ma>, "..>", <sg>,  left, [associativity]),
	edge(<sg>, "..>", <mo>,  left, [identity]),
	edge(<mo>, "..>", <gr>,  left, [inverses]),
	edge(<gr>, "..>", <agr>, left, [commutativity]),
	
	node((4,0), [*Ring*\ #text(blue, $M_n (RR)$)], name: <r>, width:w, height:h),
	node((4,1), text(size:0.75em)[*Commutative ring*\ #text(blue, $ℤ slash n ZZ, n in.not PP$)], name: <cr>, width:w, height:h),
	node((4,2), text(size:0.75em)[*Integral domain*\ #text(blue, $ℤ[sqrt(5)]$)], name: <id>, width:w, height:h),
	node((4,3), [*UFD*\ #text(blue, $ℤ[X]$)], name: <ufd>, width:w, height:h),
	node((4,4), text(size:0.75em)[*PID*\ #text(blue, $ℤ[(1+sqrt(-19))/2]$)], name: <pid>, width:w, height:h),
	node((4,5), text(size:0.75em)[*Eucledean domain*\ #text(blue, $ℤ, ZZ[i], RR[X]$)], name: <ed>, width:w, height:h),
	node((4,6), [*Field*\ #text(blue, $QQ, RR, CC, ZZ slash p ZZ$)], name: <f>, width:w, height:h),
	edge(<r>, "..>", <cr>, left, [commutativity]),
	edge(<cr>, "..>", <id>, left, [cancelation law]),
	edge(<id>, "..>", <ufd>, left, [unique\ factorization]),
	edge(<ufd>, "..>", <pid>, left, [every ideal\ is principal]),
	edge(<pid>, "..>", <ed>, left, [Eucledean\ Algorithm]),
	edge(<ed>, "..>", <f>, left, [non-zeros\ have inverses]),
	edge(<f>, "->", <vs>, bend:40deg),
	
	//node((0,7), [Legend]),
	//node(enclose: ((0,0), (1,1)), name: <big>),
 
	// edge(<ts>, "-|>", <n>, stroke: teal, label: text(teal)[snap], left),
	// edge((rel: (-15pt, 15pt), to: <n>), <ps>, "-|>", bend: 40deg, stroke: orange, text(orange)[layout], label-angle: auto)
)
#import "@preview/fletcher:0.5.8" as fletcher: diagram, node, edge
#set page(width: auto, height: auto, margin: 5mm, fill: white)
 
#diagram(
	node-defocus: 0,
	spacing: (1cm, 2cm),
	edge-stroke: 1pt,
	crossing-thickness: 5,
	mark-scale: 70%,
	node-fill: luma(97%),
	node-outset: 3pt,
	node((0,0), "magma"),
 
	node((-1,1), "semigroup"),
	node(( 0,1), "unital magma"),
	node((+1,1), "quasigroup"),
 
	node((-1,2), "monoid"),
	node(( 0,2), "inverse semigroup"),
	node((+1,2), "loop"),
 
	node(( 0,3), "group"),
 
	{
		let quad(a, b, label, paint, ..args) = {
			paint = paint.darken(25%)
			edge(a, b, text(paint, label), "-|>", stroke: paint, label-side: center, ..args)
		}
 
		quad((0,0), (-1,1), "Assoc", blue)
		quad((0,1), (-1,2), "Assoc", blue, label-pos: 0.3)
		quad((1,2), ( 0,3), "Assoc", blue)
 
		quad(( 0,0), ( 0,1), "Id", red)
		quad((-1,1), (-1,2), "Id", red, label-pos: 0.3)
		quad(( 1,1), ( 1,2), "Id", red, label-pos: 0.3)
		quad(( 0,2), ( 0,3), "Id", red)
 
		quad((0,0), (1,1), "Div", yellow)
		quad((-1,1), (0,2), "Div", yellow, label-pos: 0.3, "crossing")
 
		quad((-1,2), (0,3), "Inv", green)
		quad((0,1), ( 1,2), "Inv", green, label-pos: 0.3)
 
		quad((1,1), (0,2), "Assoc", blue, label-pos: 0.3, "crossing")
	},
)
Books

“Book of Proof” by Richard Hammack (Book of Proof)
“Mathematical Proofs: A Transition to Advanced Mathematics” by Chartrand, Polimeni and Zheng.
“Proofs: A Long-Form Mathematics Textbook” by Jay Cummings.
I think baby Hungerford and Gallian are great introductory undergrad books. If you want something a little more semi-comprehensive that’s also incredibly well written, I might suggest Aluffi or Grillet, but those are graduate books.
